compatibility.detail: Agent cards gain optional live_model (null when no usage model reported); older clients ignore the unknown field. No wire or stored-format change: the claim registry digest is unchanged, and a new operational.failure condition is read by existing fault projections.

manual.detail: Read the live model with fractal agents show <agent> --json (.live_model) or the client-v0 agent detail. The drift fault shows in fractal now and the agent's faults until usage returns to the declared model.

recovery.detail: Failure reason strings only; ordinary binary rollback applies. A fault raised by this build recovers on the next pass once usage matches the declaration.

replay.detail: No replay change; usage claims fold as before, and the fault is derived read-side state.

rules.detail: The reconciler raises a non-blocking per-seat operational failure (condition harness-model-drift, title 'Seat runs on a fallback model') when the current incarnation's latest harness.usage model differs from the declared harness model after provider/model normalization. The seat keeps running: no stop, park, or crash loop. The fault recovers when usage returns to the declared model or the declaration changes.

schema.detail: No SQL migration. New durable-adjacent read Store::latest_usage_model (indexed newest-first harness.usage lookup plus held local readings). New operational.failure condition harness-model-drift with a [drift-since-ms] reason marker.

summary: Seats that silently fall back to another model are now observable: the reconciler raises a non-blocking per-seat drift fault naming declared vs live model and since when, and agent cards expose live_model next to the declared model.
